title: A flange with no hub dimension is reported, not silently mis-placed
rule: فلنج WN بدون ابعاد → جوش روی گره می‌نشیند و لولهٔ مجاور به‌اندازهٔ hub بلندتر حساب می‌شود؛ موتور باید بگوید
note: Count was always right — one weld. The POSITION was wrong, which is worse in a way, because a weld count is checked against the MTO and a cut length is not.
